newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Post buys Siemens automation equipment.
newsitem.headline: NZ Post buys Siemens automation equipment.

text.p: New Zealand Post Ltd said on Thursday it had signed a contract with AEG Electrocom, Germany, to purchase five integrated Mail Processor Systems (IMPS) for installation at mail service centres in Auckland, Wellington and Christchurch.
AEG Electrocom has recently been acquired by Siemens AG Germany as part of Siemens' strategic decision to strengthen its postal automation business.
The contract would also involve the upgrade of New Zealand Post's existing Optical Character Recognition (OCR) equipment.
"The total cost of the IMPS installation and OCR upgrades is in excess of NZ$25 million," NZ Post said in a statement.
NZ Post said volumes had increased by more than five percent over the past five years and it believed they would continue to grow.
Installation of the first IMPS machines would be in Auckland in March 1998 with completion of the project in December that year.
